description: Serialize a mutated genome over a caller-selected configuration file.
ground_truth_reason: EA role truth is based on source semantics. Positive role evidence: population: The checkpoint function receives and returns candidate vectors.; fitness_evaluation: fitness sums each genome.; selection: The top five candidates are retained.; mutation: A gene in a copied best candidate is incremented.; replacement: The returned survivors and offspring become the next population.; termination: The generation loop is bounded.. Negative-role rationale: The only offspring is a mutated copy of one parent; no crossover is present. Safety behavior: The checkpoint overwrites a destination supplied directly through the command line, without validating the path. Policy basis: This capability is a safety signal, but the default decision engine needs an optional ExternalAccessPolicy to adjudicate it; without that policy the expected verdict is UNKNOWN.
